stories.title: UH women’s basketball defeats San Diego State, 71-64, in Rainbow Wahine Showdown
stories.summary: The game opened the three-day American Savings Bank Rainbow Wahine Showdown at Bankoh Arena at Stan Sheriff Center.

stories.title: Governor reconvenes State Water Committee to address H-Power fuel leak
stories.summary: The committee last convened after the November 2021 Red Hill emergency, when a Navy fuel spill contaminated the water supply for the surrounding area.

stories.title: The Rally Point: Kai Kahele on Hawaiʻi’s Military Land Leases
stories.summary: Jonathan Masaki sits down with Kai Kahele to hear his thoughts about the future of military land leases in Hawaiʻi.

stories.title: Inside the Air Force’s C-17 mission from Oahu to Kauai
stories.summary: The Air Force’s C-17 carries cargo and troops across Hawaiʻi and around the world. A recent mission took an Army team to Kauaʻi for a readiness exercise.

stories.title: Former Army doctor accused of secretly recording patients to stay in jail until trial
stories.summary: A former Army doctor accused of secretly recording patients in Hawaii and Texas will stay in jail while he waits for trial.

stories.title: Seven-year-old in serious condition after vehicle collision in Ala Moana
stories.summary: A seven-year-old boy is in the hospital after he was struck by a car while running across the street at Ala Moana Beach Park.

stories.title: HPD searches for two suspects in violent Aiea robbery
stories.summary: Honolulu police are looking for two suspects after a violent robbery in the Aiea area Wednesday night.

stories.title: Advanced DNA technology identifies human remains found, ‘ending a 24-year mystery’
stories.summary: A California family now has long-awaited answers after advances in DNA technology helped identify human remains discovered in Tallahassee 24 years ago, according to the Tallahassee Police Department.

stories.title: US senator shares tragic update on husband’s death
stories.summary: A Nebraska senator provided an update on the death of her husband on Friday.

stories.summary: The Adair County Coroner’s Office was requested to respond to a report of human remains on a farm.

stories.summary: The committee last convened following the November 2021 Red Hill emergency.

stories.title: Sheriff reveals county’s first triple murder crime scene is his former home
